title: Smiling Boy in Patterned Sweater Vest, 1950 Backyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot featuring a young boy standing smiling in a grassy yard beside a flowering bush and brick steps. He is dressed in a patterned knit sweater vest over a collared shirt, dark trousers, and white shoes. The reverse side features deckled edges, a handwritten date of 'may 1950', and a stamped '620' print/film code, illustrating mid-century post-war family life and childhood fashion.
